elo.name: Elo ratings
elo.about: Our Elo ratings, overall and by surface: each match moves them by how surprising the result was.

serve.name: Serve and return model
serve.about: Serve and return strength inferred from scores against the quality of the opposition, and the hold and break rates they imply.

forecast.name: Match and season forecasts
forecast.about: Our match forecast (Elo blended with the serve and return model) and the rest-of-season simulation: wins against it, projected ranks and chances.

elo: Overall strength rating from every result, adjusted for the opponent's rating.
games_won_pct: Share of all games won in completed sets; steadier than win % because every game counts.
hold: How often the player holds serve against an average tour returner, inferred from set scores.
brk: How often the player breaks an average tour server, inferred from set scores.
win_v_top50: Share of matches won against opponents ranked in the top 50.
elo_clay: Strength rating from matches on clay only.
elo_grass: Strength rating from matches on grass only.
hold_plus_break: Hold % plus break %; above 100 % wins more service and return games combined than an average player.
serve_rating: Serve strength inferred from scores, on a log-odds scale (0 = tour average).
return_rating: Return strength inferred from scores, on a log-odds scale (0 = tour average).
win_pct: Share of hard-court tour-level matches won.
elo_hard: Strength rating from matches on hard courts only.
elo_peak: Highest overall Elo reached during the season.
avg_opp_elo: Mean Elo of the opponents faced.
win_v_top10: Share of matches won against top-10 opponents.
win_v_top20: Share of matches won against top-20 opponents.
tb_per_set: How often a set reaches a tiebreak: a serve-dominance style marker.
games_per_set: Average games per set: higher for serve-dominated players.
tb_pct: Share of tiebreaks won (mostly luck over one season).
dec_pct: Share of deciding sets won (mostly luck over one season).
dominance: Return points won % divided by serve points lost %; above 1.0 wins more return points than it concedes on serve. WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
ace_pct: Aces per serve point. WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
spw_real: Share of serve points won (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
rpw_real: Share of return points won (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
tpw: Share of all points won (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
hold_real: Service games held (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
brk_real: Return games broken (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
first_in: First serves in per serve point (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
first_won: Points won when the first serve lands (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
second_won: Points won on the second serve (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
df_pct: Double faults per serve point (WTA statistics). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
bp_saved_pct: Share of break points faced that were saved (WTA statistics; mostly noise). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
bp_conv_pct: Share of break points won on return (WTA statistics; mostly noise). WTA matches with statistics, 2016 on (not the Slams).
